back.en: Water lets acids ionise to form H₃O⁺ (H⁺); no water → no acidic properties
back.bm: Air membolehkan asid mengion membentuk H₃O⁺ (H⁺); tiada air → tiada sifat asid

back.en: Base reacts with acid to give salt + water; alkali is a base that dissolves in water (gives OH⁻)
back.bm: Bes bertindak balas dengan asid memberi garam + air; alkali ialah bes yang larut dalam air (memberi OH⁻)

back.en: Strong: ionises completely (HCl). Weak: ionises partially (CH₃COOH)
back.bm: Kuat: mengion lengkap (HCl). Lemah: mengion separa (CH₃COOH)
Garam + air + CO₂ (pembuakan; air kapur keruh)

back.en: Salt + water + ammonia (turns damp red litmus blue)
back.bm: Garam + air + ammonia (litmus merah lembap menjadi biru)

back.en: mol dm⁻³ (molarity) or g dm⁻³; g dm⁻³ = mol dm⁻³ × molar mass
back.bm: mol dm⁻³ (kemolaran) atau g dm⁻³; g dm⁻³ = mol dm⁻³ × jisim molar

back.en: Weigh solute exactly, dissolve, transfer to volumetric flask with rinsings, top up to the mark, invert to mix
back.bm: Timbang zat terlarut dengan tepat, larutkan, pindah ke kelalang volumetrik bersama bilasan, tambah air hingga tanda, terbalikkan untuk campur

back.en: M_aV_a / M_bV_b = a/b (a, b = mole ratio from equation)
back.bm: M_aV_a / M_bV_b = a/b (a, b = nisbah mol daripada persamaan)

back.en: Antacids for gastric pain, lime for acidic soil, baking soda for bee stings, treating factory waste
back.bm: Antasid untuk gastrik, kapur untuk tanah berasid, soda penaik untuk sengatan lebah, merawat sisa kilang

back.en: All Na⁺, K⁺, NH₄⁺ salts and nitrates soluble. Insoluble: AgCl, PbCl₂, BaSO₄, PbSO₄, CaSO₄, most carbonates
back.bm: Semua garam Na⁺, K⁺, NH₄⁺ dan nitrat larut. Tidak larut: AgCl, PbCl₂, BaSO₄, PbSO₄, CaSO₄, kebanyakan karbonat

back.en: Na/K/NH₄ salts: titration. Others: excess metal/oxide/carbonate + acid, filter, crystallise
back.bm: Garam Na/K/NH₄: pentitratan. Lain-lain: logam/oksida/karbonat berlebihan + asid, turas, hablurkan

back.en: Metal oxide + CO₂ (Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃ don't decompose). ZnO yellow hot/white cold; CuO black; PbO brown hot/yellow cold
back.bm: Oksida logam + CO₂ (Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃ tidak terurai). ZnO kuning panas/putih sejuk; CuO hitam; PbO perang panas/kuning sejuk

back.en: Cl⁻: AgNO₃ → white ppt. SO₄²⁻: BaCl₂ → white ppt. CO₃²⁻: acid → CO₂. NO₃⁻: brown ring test
back.bm: Cl⁻: AgNO₃ → mendakan putih. SO₄²⁻: BaCl₂ → mendakan putih. CO₃²⁻: asid → CO₂. NO₃⁻: ujian cincin perang

back.en: H₂ pop; O₂ relights glowing splinter; CO₂ limewater chalky; NH₃ red litmus blue; Cl₂ bleaches damp litmus
back.bm: H₂ 'pop'; O₂ menyalakan kayu uji berbara; CO₂ air kapur keruh; NH₃ litmus merah biru; Cl₂ melunturkan litmus lembap
